import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[12][12];
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] DR = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] DC = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static class Cell {
        int r, c;
        Cell(int r, int c) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static void bfs_search(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], false);
        }
        Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
        visited[sr][sc] = true;
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new Cell(sr, sc));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = cur.r + DR[i];
                int nc = cur.c + DC[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < n && nc >= 0 && nc < n && !visited[nr][nc] && Character.isDigit(grid1[nr][nc])) {
                    visited[nr][nc] = true;
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[cur.r][cur.c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Cell(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[72][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] can_reach = new boolean[12][12][12][12];

    static int[][] edge = new int[290][290];
    static int[] prev_node = new int[290];
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[290];

    static boolean find_path() {
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        Arrays.fill(prev_node, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        in_queue[0] = true;
        q.offer(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (u == 2 * n * n + 1) return true;
            for (int v = 0; v <= 2 * n * n + 1; ++v) {
                if (edge[u][v] > 0 && !in_queue[v]) {
                    in_queue[v] = true;
                    prev_node[v] = u;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void run() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            grid1[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            grid2[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        int start_r = sc.nextInt();
        int start_c = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    start_r = i;
                    start_c = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs_search(start_r, start_c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 72; ++i) {
            for (int pr = 0; pr < 12; ++pr) {
                for (int pc = 0; pc < 12; ++pc) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < 12; ++r) {
                        Arrays.fill(dp[i][pr][pc][r], false);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int step = 0; step < t; ++step) {
            for (int pr = 0; pr < n; ++pr) {
                for (int pc = 0; pc < n; ++pc) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < n; ++c) {
                            if (!dp[step][pr][pc][r][c]) continue;
                            if (dist[r][c] <= step) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                                int nr = r + DR[d];
                                int nc = c + DC[d];
                                if (nr >= 0 && nr < n && nc >= 0 && nc < n && Character.isDigit(grid1[nr][nc]) && dist[nr][nc] >= step + 1) {
                                    dp[step + 1][pr][pc][nr][nc] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int pr = 0; pr < 12; ++pr) {
            for (int pc = 0; pc < 12; ++pc) {
                for (int r = 0; r < 12; ++r) {
                    Arrays.fill(can_reach[pr][pc][r], false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int step = 0; step <= t; ++step) {
            for (int pr = 0; pr < n; ++pr) {
                for (int pc = 0; pc < n; ++pc) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < n; ++c) {
                            if (dp[step][pr][pc][r][c]) {
                                can_reach[pr][pc][r][c] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 290; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(edge[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    edge[0][i * n + j + 1] = grid1[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2[i][j])) {
                    edge[n * n + i * n + j + 1][2 * n * n + 1] = grid2[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (!Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                        if (!Character.isDigit(grid1[k][l])) continue;
                        if (!can_reach[i][j][k][l]) continue;
                        edge[i * n + j + 1][n * n + k * n + l + 1] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        while (find_path()) {
            int flow = INF;
            for (int u = 2 * n * n + 1; u != 0; u = prev_node[u]) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, edge[prev_node[u]][u]);
            }
            for (int u = 2 * n * n + 1; u != 0; u = prev_node[u]) {
                edge[prev_node[u]][u] -= flow;
                edge[u][prev_node[u]] += flow;
            }
        }
        int max_flow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * n * n + 1; ++i) {
            max_flow += edge[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        run();
    }
}
